HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Dutch low angle: Kangrim mid-lift under a stuck wooden axle on a Huaxia post-road, muscles modelled, face calm and polite. LEFT of sheet = mortal Kangrim face ONLY; RIGHT = Western Empire / Huaxia rite board for mile-post, inn timber, Han-style eaves — ignore board faces. ONE device: the axle as a dark horizontal bar across the frame. Day high-key pale dust, long shadows. He is still whole and strong. Hex #4a4a58 in iron tire specular. No army. No text. No watermark.
